authority.scope: new source39-only reference-guided learner and fixed preprocessing diagnosis; old studies remain closed

preprocessing.shared_access: same current-trial available prefix[0:160+N] for both arms; no later sample, other query history or batch statistics
preprocessing.no_notch: crop[160:160+N] contiguousfloat64 after pinned loader float32 conversion; unchanged prior spatial crop
preprocessing.causal_notch50: scipy.signal.iirnotch(50,35,fs=250); lfilter(b,a,current-trial prefix,axis=time), zero initial state independently perchannel/trial; then crop[160:160+N]
preprocessing.filterbank: same fixed7band Chebyshev1; crop after optional causalnotch but BEFORE bank filtering; zero-phase bank uses retainedwindow only
preprocessing.claim_boundary: causal-notch preprocessing effect includes .64s preceding history; not an isolated proof of physical50Hz cause, not exact full-epoch DAN filtfilt, not upstream acquisition-causality validation
preprocessing.normalization: time-center each channel after filtering for CCA; no zscore, no resampling, no manifest/QC, no metadata descriptors

decoder.reference_generation: same public float32 sine/cosine5harmonics then float64; center each row; full sine/cosine subspace, no fixed-phase constraint
decoder.CCA_estimation: center in time; covariance/(N-1); relative ridge*trace(C)/channels for each side; symmetric inverse-square-root cutoff max(eps,largest_eigenvalue*1e-12); leading SVD pair maps back to original coordinates; public cca_score constant-energy handling; zero degenerate coefficients
decoder.ECCA_features: X=query, Tj=mean firstk labeled filtered trials, Yc=fixed candidate reference. (u1,v1)=CCA(X,Yc),(u2,v2)=CCA(X,Tj),(u3,v3)=CCA(Tj,Yc). r1=Pearson(u1.T X,v1.T Yc); r2=Pearson(u2.T X,u2.T Tj); r3=Pearson(u1.T X,u1.T Tj); r4=Pearson(u3.T X,u3.T Tj). r1 is actual projected Pearson, not penalized singularvalue. Paired sign chosen positive for r1; shared-filter terms invariant to eigenvector sign.
decoder.ECCA_score: sum_f(w_f*sum_i(sign(r_i)*r_i^2))/sum_f(w_f); no second squaring, no division by4; fixed four-feature operator, no further learned mixture
decoder.A0_reference: exact same r1 as ECCA, score=sum_f(w_f*r1^2)/sum_f(w_f), same preprocessing; independent standalone probability T
decoder.ITCCA: prior spatial pairwise regularizedCCA query vs classmean template; bandweighted rho^2 normalizedsumweights; diagnostic bothpipelines
decoder.legacy_A0: original public raw-crop FBCCA score normalizedsumweights; no_notch only; diagnostic historical anchor, not matched ECCA reference
decoder.wrong_label_support: shift1..11 assigns template j=(c-shift)%12 to fixed candidatec; referencesYc and querylabels NEVER move; recompute/reuse correct pair-specific filters for all(X,Tj),(Tj,Yc) combinations; same true-label ECCA T; average metrics not posteriors; finalscore roll forbidden
decoder.k0: ECCA andwrong exactmatched A0_reference alias with support terms unavailable, not fabricated; wrongpermutations0; ITCCA unavailable
decoder.degenerate: Pearson zero when either centered projected norm<=0, clip[-1,1]; zero-energy CCA outputs0; log floor1e-300; argmax firstclass on exacttie

fitting.outer_folds: sorted39 position modulo3: fit26/evaluate13; freeze allthree folds before outerevaluation; not independent newparticipants or nestedvalidation
fitting.fit_unit: pipeline/window/method/availablebudget, all fitparticipants and both interfaces equally pooled; no interface-conditioned heads
fitting.temperature_fits: per pipeline/window A0_reference oneT shared allk, ECCA threeT k1/3/5, ITCCA threeT; legacy_A0 oneT perwindow only; wronglabel shares trueECCA T
fitting.objective: standalone posterior NLL; no lambda or postoutcome retuning

diagnostics.ecca_components: true-label fourfeature coefficients for everyband, pipeline,cell,budget,query,class; wronglabel aggregate scores stored separately forquota
diagnostics.support_correlations: eachband/class first5support trials channel-time-centered then flattened Pearson5x5; all orderedoffdiagonal20pairs used for reproducibility summary; zeroenergy0, diagonalnotincludedinreportedmean
diagnostics.reference_projection_fraction: for eachband/all10blocks/trueclass/all12candidate refs: centered EEG energy projected onto centered reference rowspace divided by totalchannel-timeenergy; SVD basis keeps sigma>max(eps,sigma_max*1e-12), zeroenergy0; descriptive only never modelinput
diagnostics.line50_fraction: same rowspace energy fraction for50Hz sine/cosine on retainedcrop BEFORE bank, after optional notch; report source support/query separately, no fitted frequencysearch
diagnostics.report: all7bands/all6cells/bothpipelines, no bestband choice; participant means correct-v-meanwrong/maxwrong score margins, classificationaccuracy, projectedenergy and supportreproducibility; diagnostics are descriptive, not causal physical attribution

reporting.unit: 39 previouslyexposed participants, mean over all6cells; descriptive Studentt df38 CIs, no sharedtraining dependence correction
reporting.per_pipeline_screens: ECCA-minus-A0_reference earlyAUC mean>=.01 andone-sided95LCB>0; ECCA-minus-wrong earlyAUC same; all6 k1gainmean>=0; each dry/wet earlyAUCgainmean>=-.005 andLCB>-1/60. Allpass=>USEFUL_EEG_CALIBRATION_DEVELOPMENT elseAQ_NOT_ESTABLISHED for thatpipeline only
reporting.paired_pipeline_diagnostics: participant [(ECCA-Aref)eAUC_causalnotch-(ECCA-Aref)eAUC_nonotch]; causalnotch-minus-nonotch eAUC forECCA/Aref/wrong andBAk1/3/5 ITCCA; descriptive only noselectiongate
reporting.controls_and_cost: all11wrong metrics, k0null, percell/participant harm vs matchedAref, firstobserved budget reaching.8 else>5,12klabels,12k*N/250retainedEEGseconds and separately.64s historypertrial; no totalwallclock savings claim
reporting.terminal_interpretation: completion is not utility; reportboth separate pipeline screens even if bothfail; no selectedwinner, no automaticmetadata/heldpromotion, no independent efficacy or SOTA/exactauthorreproduction claim

execution.publication: cleancommittedsource/exactplan/pins; exclusive0400fsync; startbeforehuman EEG open; allfolds publishbeforeeval; existingstart consumesattempt,noautomaticretry
